Benchmark: runs the heavy mode with a fixed camera, without an FPS limit, once with each set of options being tested (about 2 to 3 minutes), and shows which is fastest on this phone.
The world and everything built in it are deleted for good.

An original block game made for HyPocket, open source and not related to any other game. Collect blocks and build with them (or pick creative mode for unlimited blocks), and keep your worlds. Days pass and nights get dark: light them with lamps. It runs through the same path a real game will (x86-64 translator, desktop OpenGL and the direct display). Works with touch, game controllers, keyboards and mice (click to capture the pointer). The render scale, FPS limit, dynamic resolution and camera sensitivity are in Settings.
Heavy mode: 300 wandering creatures and a longer view (and a world four times larger in the quick game)
Left: walk · Right: drag to look, tap to break · Bottom: choose a block
Left stick: walk · Right stick: look · A: jump · X/RT: break · B/LT: place · Y: next block · Select: inventory · Start: exit
Mouse: move to look · Left button: break · Right button: place · Wheel or 1-9: block · I: inventory · WASD: walk · Space: jump · Esc: free the pointer

Unlimited blocks of every kind. Nothing to collect.
Survival: break blocks to collect them, and build with what you collected.
Choose a place in the bar, then the block to put there. Controller: d-pad and A, B closes. Keyboard: arrows and Enter, I closes.
Holding the time does not change the time kept in the world: back on 15-minute days, it continues where it was.
